programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Big Daddy

programme.desc: A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie

programme.desc: Two police officers begin to question their partnership after each infiltrates different cliques while undercover at a local college.

programme.title: Coming 2 America
programme.desc: Needing a male heir to the throne, Prince Akeem returns to Queens, N.Y., to find his long-lost son and bring him back to Zamunda.

programme.desc: A pair of idiotic friends set off on a madcap journey to return a briefcase to its owner. However, they are blissfully unaware that the case contains a large amount of ransom money for the owner's kidnapped husband. Their trip is soon fraught with disaster, especially when the kidnappers begin to pursue them across the country with the aim of grabbing the cash.

programme.desc: In the 80s, Harry meets Lloyd in high school, where they cross paths with a mean principal and a bunch of other outcasts, much like themselves. They are put in a `special needs' class, and attempt to get out.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy

programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil

programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: Ladies vs Ricky Bahl
programme.desc: A conman who earns his bread and butter by conning women ends up getting conned when a bunch of women team up to get revenge.

programme.title: Dil To Pagal Hai
programme.desc: Rahul is the director of a successful music and dance group and considers Nisha his best friend. Secretly, she is madly in love with him. Following an injury, new dancer Pooja joins the company and Rahul finds himself falling for her, but she is engaged to Ajay who is the son of the family who raised Pooja following her parents' death. As preparations for the new show progress, will Rahul decide on a happy ending?

programme.title: Main Tera Hero
programme.desc: A mischievous college student becomes entangled in a love triangle with two attractive girls. One of them is promised to a corrupt policeman, while the other is the pampered daughter of a notorious crime lord.

programme.title: Ek Villain
programme.desc: When his lover becomes the latest victim of a serial killer, Guru blurs the line between good and evil in his pursuit of revenge.

programme.title: Mantostaan
programme.desc: Based on four controversial short stories of the legendary Urdu writer Saadat Hasan Manto. Shedding light on the inhumane side of mankind.

programme.title: Rowdy Sarkar
programme.desc: A man rules over his people in Rayalaseema, and they revere him as God. When an upcoming project threatens the well-being of his people, he opposes it. In the bargain, he makes some dangerous enemies.

programme.title: The Masterpiece
programme.desc: A portrait photographer tries to capture two key expressions from his girlfriend for a top contest, risking their relationship and his sanity in the process.

programme.title: Salaam Namaste
programme.desc: Following a group of East Indian immigrants as they cope with life and cultural differences in Melbourne, Australia.

programme.title: Namak Halaal
programme.desc: A hotel worker befriends the man his mother cast him aside for and raised as her own son.

programme.title: Mohabbatein
programme.desc: A heartbroken music teacher helps three soul-stirring love stories thrive amid the turmoil of his decade-long conflict with a cold-hearted college principal.

programme.title: Dream Girl 2
programme.desc: Karam secretly turns his female alter ego into a dancer and woos a millionaire's son in hopes of clearing his family debts and impressing his fiancée's father.

programme.title: Kesari Chapter 2
programme.desc: After learning the truth behind the brutal massacre at the Jallianwala Bagh, C Sankaran Nair, a member of the Viceroy's Council, sets out to challenge the Crown and the military general responsible.

programme.title: Kalank
programme.desc: Long-buried secrets come to light when romance blossoms between a young daredevil and a beautiful woman in 1945 India.

programme.title: Vijay The Master

programme.title: Hawa

programme.title: Rocket Singh: Salesman of the Year
programme.desc: Harpreet Singh Bedi has just graduated, and his marks are a little embarrassing, but marks never stopped him from dreaming of an exciting and adventurous career, and they never will. It is the sometimes thoughtless, sometimes thoughtful story of a fresh graduate trying to find a balance between the maddening demands of the 'professional' way, and the way of his heart.

programme.title: Kaagaz 2
programme.desc: The Struggles of a common man whose right to life is infringed upon by protests and rallies.

programme.title: Total Siyapaa
programme.desc: A guy's plans to impress his Indian girlfriend's parents fall apart when they discover that he is Pakistani.

programme.title: Duplicate
programme.desc: An escaped prisoner attempts to assume the identity of his lookalike, an unsuspecting chef, so he can evade the law and seek vengeance on those who double-crossed him.

programme.title: Hum Kisi Se Kum Nahin
programme.desc: While attacking one of his enemies, Munna Bhai, a criminal from Mumbai, sees Komal and is so taken by her beauty that he starts thinking about her wherever he goes.

programme.title: Badrinath Ki Dulhania

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

Among the more intriguing finds are a very rare piece of silver which was dug up in a garden, a car powered by steam which arrives with two elegantly-dressed visitors, and a set of original illustrations for `Winnie the Pooh' valued at over £50,000.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: At the Museum of Science and Industry in Manchester, there are items from around the world, including an Inuit carving, a French book of butterflies and a ship that sailed the China seas. The experts are Anita Manning and Micheal Baggott.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Catherine Bohart, Chesney Hawkes, Rebecca Keatley and Jason Mohammad take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor serves up more Strictly exclusives and looks ahead to the weekend with a brand new all-star panel. Plus a sneak peek at the couples' first rehearsals on the ballroom floor.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: Featuring extensive coverage of the day's top national and international news stories, along with explanations about the context and potential aftereffects.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham is joined by Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin for a lively, curiosity-fuelled exploration of Britain's wildlife, tackling the fascinating, the unexpected and the downright bizarre.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Winter may be closing in, but Adam Frost has thrown on his warm coat and is sharing some practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Set in Roman times, the story of a once-powerful general forced to become a common gladiator. The emperor's son is enraged when he is passed over as heir in favour of his father's favourite general. He kills his father and arranges the murder of the general's family, and the general is sold into slavery to be trained as a gladiator - but his subsequent popularity in the arena threatens the throne.

programme.title: Coriolanus
programme.desc: Banished from the city he once served, a former war hero joins forces with an old enemy to bring about the downfall of Rome.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: In the fourth leg, the teams enter a new frontier, Australia. The sixth-largest country on the planet and home to eight distinct climate zones, it's a land of extreme contrasts.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: As the journey moves into County Clare, Bill and Tom discover that keeping a low profile isn't easy, while an emotional reunion reveals the kindness at the heart of their Irish adventure.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: After a lab mishap, Looph's new 'size-o-matic' machine misfires, causing her to shrink! Now tiny, can she find a clever way to alert her friends and turn everything back to normal?

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Rex is missing, but Dad, Cosima and Big Lizard need him to save them from a giant slug.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings are exhausted and just want to sleep, but Weasy starts snoring.

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: The heroes accidentally agree to let Mr Friendlyface's niece tag along on a quest and worry that her lack of hero skills will ruin everything.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a mask that terrifies anyone who looks at it.

programme.title: Duck and Frog
programme.desc: Duck is working in a florist, and Frog is a customer who wants to send flowers to his secret crush. However, his strong fragrance sends Duck into a destructive sneezing frenzy.

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
programme.desc: Dot and Penny infiltrate Exceed's server room, but obstacles await.

programme.title: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: The Princess Ball descends into chaos when Vexius and the Trix crash the party.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: Heath thinks Jax is ashamed of him, and Damian questions Layla's motives.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Abby and Leo go head-to-head in a festive blacksmith challenge.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Winter may be closing in, but Adam Frost has thrown on his warm coat and is sharing some practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months.

programme.title: Life in a Cottage Garden with Carol Klein
programme.desc: The frosts have not yet released their grip on the garden, and the devastation of a hard winter is scattered all around. There is much to do, cutting back, preparing the soil and garlic planting. The first green shoots of the year begin to appear, as drifts of snowdrops carpet the woodland floor and hellebores reveal their ravishing colours. A local woodsman joins Carol to lay a native hedge. Slowly the first signs of spring appear.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham is joined by Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin for a lively, curiosity-fuelled exploration of Britain's wildlife, tackling the fascinating, the unexpected and the downright bizarre.

programme.title: Whisky Galore!
programme.desc: Classic Ealing comedy about a scotch-laden ship that runs aground off the coast of the Outer Hebrides during the Second World War. The local islanders have depleted their supply of the amber nectar and are overjoyed at the thought of stocking up again. However, it is Sunday, and the teetotallers object to making free with the unexpected cargo.

programme.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
programme.desc: Marcus makes plans to expand the smallholding's herb patch. A trip to Gloucestershire to see the UK's largest herb collection shows that even someone as experienced as Marcus can still learn a lot about ingredients.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Martin is in Bath, Somerset, looking around a characterful, Grade II-listed one-bedroom flat. He also visits Stoke-on-Trent to see a two-bed terrace with a very interesting story. And Martel is in Featherstone, West Yorkshire, where a pair of terraced houses split into four flats makes for an interesting auction lot.

programme.title: Kelly's Heroes
programme.desc: World War II adventure about an American soldier who captures a German officer and discovers that his prisoner knows the whereabouts of $16 million in Nazi gold. Getting the colonel drunk, he finds out where the bullion is - it's lying behind enemy lines. The soldier quickly gathers a crew of military misfits to help him with his unusual and daring robbery.

programme.title: Final Score
programme.desc: Jason Mohammad and guests bring you all the goals, latest drama, analysis, reaction and interviews.
